result.instructions: Tools for Calendesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What bookings do we have for Friday, and who is each one with?"; "Which time slots are free for the 60-minute consultation next week?"; "Cancel the booking for Anna on 12 December and do not send a notification.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Calendesk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run calendesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run calendesk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run calendesk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. calendesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: calendesk_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the bookable services of the tenant (name, duration, price, category). Good first call to find a service id for a booking. Calendesk API: GET /admin/services.

tools.name: calendesk_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Get one service by id, with its types, locations and settings. Calendesk API: GET /admin/services/{serviceId}.

tools.name: calendesk_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List service categories, with their active or inactive status. Calendesk API: GET /admin/categories.

tools.name: calendesk_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees (staff who take bookings), with their account status and public visibility. Calendesk API: GET /admin/employees.

status.description: Filter by the employee's account status.

is_public.description: true: only public employees; false: only non-public ones.

tools.name: calendesk_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Calendesk API: GET /admin/employees/{id}.

tools.name: calendesk_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings with filters for date range, employee, service, customer, status and payment. Use it for schedules and reports. Calendesk API: GET /admin/bookings/v2.

booking_date_from.description: Bookings that start on or after this date.

booking_date_to.description: Bookings that start on or before this date.

paid.description: true: paid bookings only; false: unpaid only.

email.description: Filter by the customer's e-mail (exact match).

tools.name: calendesk_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: time, employee, service, customer, status and payment. Calendesk API: GET /admin/bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: calendesk_get_available_slots
tools.title: Get available slots
tools.description: Get the free booking times for one service over a number of days from a start date. Times can be converted to the customer's time zone. Calendesk API: GET /available-slots.

service_type_id.description: A service type id, when the service has types.

customer_time_zone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Warsaw.

tools.name: calendesk_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search and list customers (users) by name, e-mail, status or creation date. Calendesk API: GET /admin/v2/users.

created_from.description: Customers created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Customers created on or before this date.

tools.name: calendesk_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer (user) by id. Calendesk API: GET /admin/users/{id}.

tools.name: calendesk_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: Create a booking for an employee and a service on a date. Sends the customer and staff notifications unless skip_notifications is true. A recurring booking needs the API's recurrence fields, which this tool does not set. Calendesk API: POST /admin/bookings.

end_date.description: End date, yyyy-mm-dd (the same as start_date for a single-day booking).

all_day_event.description: true: the booking covers the whole day (no times).

user_id.description: The customer id. Omit it for an internal booking.

tools.name: calendesk_update_booking
tools.title: Update booking
tools.description: Change one booking: time, employee, service, status or payment. To cancel a booking, set status to cancelled. Sends notifications unless skip_notifications is true. Calendesk API: PATCH /admin/bookings/{bookingId}.

status.description: New status. cancelled cancels the booking.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Calendesk
prompts.description: What you can do with Calendesk here, with example requests to try.
